'''Carl Mike Hardy EBO Turbo''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''EBO Turbo'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it on 25 April 2000.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Carl Mike Hardy]]
* '''Published:''' 25 April 2000 (Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' EBO Turbo
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor MPG Hardy LS 2000 Red32.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Well, just so that you can prepare for it. Here's what your usual, run of the mill, EBO decks might look like now that A New Secret Base is out. It's main power relies on it's overall speed. With Secret Base, you can grab Echo Base Garrison and use that to get your Bantha droid and the Warroom (or any Echo Base site with a scomp link for that matter). Deploy the droid there and play as many How Did We Get Into This Mess's as you can, deploying Echo sites and the cheap to deploy Talz's. You should be able to grab Echo Base Operations and deploy it by the second turn, third turn at the latest! Once EBO is up, deploy systems and X-wings like a mad fiend! Be sure to save a decent amount of Force for Barriers and Hyper Escapes if you feel you're going up against strong space resistance. You have the engredients for the Super Falcon to use as a strike unit if the Dark get's sassy in sapce against you. Remember to protect yourself with Hyper Escapes and Barriers... Houjix out of a jam if you have to. The key to this deck is not battling yet, running like a little child nad draining for insane amounts. This may not be the ultimate in EBO tech... But, it gives you a foundation through which you can build an adequite defense.
